<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>CV. SOPHIYAN PUTRA MANDIRI | Material Bangunan Purwakarta</title>

<meta name="description" content="CV. SOPHIYAN PUTRA MANDIRI menyediakan batu belah, pasir, batu split dan beskos untuk kebutuhan proyek dan konstruksi di Purwakarta dan sekitarnya.">

<style>
*{
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
  font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
  background:#0b0d10;
  color:#fff;
  line-height:1.6;
}

a{
  text-decoration:none;
  color:inherit;
}

.container{
  width:min(1120px,92%);
  margin:auto;
}

/* HEADER */
header{
  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:1000;
  background:rgba(8,10,13,.94);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,160,46,.25);
}

.nav{
  min-height:78px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:20px;
}

.brand{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
}

.logo{
  width:58px;
  height:58px;
  border-radius:50%;
  display:block;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center;
  flex:none;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(217,165,46,.45), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

.brand strong{
  display:block;
  font-size:15px;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.brand span{
  color:#d9a52e;
  font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:2px;
}

nav{
  display:flex;
  gap:24px;
  font-size:14px;
}

nav a:hover{
  color:#d9a52e;
}

/* HERO */
.hero{
  min-height:680px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 30%,rgba(212,160,46,.20),transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#080a0d,#15191f);
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.hero:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:500px;
  height:500px;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,46,.15);
  border-radius:50%;
  right:-180px;
  top:80px;
}

.hero-content{
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
  max-width:760px;
}

.badge{
  display:inline-block;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,46,.5);
  color:#d9a52e;
  padding:8px 15px;
  border-radius:30px;
  font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:1.5px;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}

h1{
  font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,76px);
  line-height:1.05;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}

.gold{
  color:#d9a52e;
}

.hero p{
  max-width:650px;
  color:#c8cbd0;
  font-size:18px;
  margin-bottom:30px;
}

.buttons{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:12px;
}

.btn{
  display:inline-block;
  padding:14px 22px;
  border-radius:8px;
  font-weight:bold;
  transition:.25s;
}

.btn-primary{
  background:#d9a52e;
  color:#080a0d;
}

.btn-primary:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px);
  background:#efbd43;
}

.btn-outline{
  border:1px solid #555;
  color:white;
}

.btn-outline:hover{
  border-color:#d9a52e;
  color:#d9a52e;
}

/* RUNNING TEXT */
.running{
  background:#d9a52e;
  color:#080a0d;
  padding:10px 0;
  overflow:hidden;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:bold;
  letter-spacing:1px;
  white-space:nowrap;
}

.running div{
  animation:move 20s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes move{
  from{transform:translateX(100%);}
  to{transform:translateX(-100%);}
}

/* SECTION */
section{
  padding:90px 0;
}

.section-title{
  text-align:center;
  max-width:700px;
  margin:0 auto 50px;
}

.section-title small{
  color:#d9a52e;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:3px;
}

.section-title h2{
  font-size:38px;
  margin:10px 0;
}

.section-title p{
  color:#aeb2b8;
}

/* ABOUT */
.about{
  background:#101318;
}

.about-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:50px;
  align-items:center;
}

.about-box{
  border:1px solid #292e35;
  padding:35px;
  border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#15191f,#0d0f12);
}

.about-box h3{
  color:#d9a52e;
  margin-bottom:15px;
}

.about-box p{
  color:#c4c7cc;
}

/* PRODUCTS */
.products{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:20px;
}

.card{
  background:#111419;
  border:1px solid #292e35;
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:28px 20px;
  transition:.3s;
}

.card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-7px);
  border-color:#d9a52e;
}

.icon{
  font-size:42px;
  margin-bottom:15px;
}

.card h3{
  margin-bottom:8px;
}

.card p{
  color:#aeb2b8;
  font-size:14px;
  min-height:65px;
}

.price{
  color:#d9a52e;
  font-weight:bold;
  margin:15px 0;
}

/* WHY US */
.why{
  background:#101318;
}

.features{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:20px;
}

.feature{
  text-align:center;
  padding:25px 15px;
}

.feature strong{
  display:block;
  margin:10px 0;
  font-size:18px;
}

.feature p{
  color:#999fa7;
  font-size:14px;
}

/* PROCESS */
.process{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:20px;
}

.step{
  position:relative;
  text-align:center;
}

.number{
  width:55px;
  height:55px;
  margin:auto;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#d9a52e;
  color:#080a0d;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  font-weight:900;
  font-size:20px;
}

.step h3{
  margin:15px 0 7px;
}

.step p{
  color:#999fa7;
  font-size:14px;
}

/* CTA */
.cta{
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(8,10,13,.85),rgba(8,10,13,.95)),
    radial-gradient(circle at center,#4a3610,#080a0d);
  text-align:center;
}

.cta h2{
  font-size:42px;
  margin-bottom:15px;
}

.cta p{
  color:#bbb;
  margin-bottom:25px;
}

/* CONTACT */
.contact{
  background:#101318;
}

.contact-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:25px;
}

.contact-card{
  border:1px solid #292e35;
  padding:30px;
  border-radius:16px;
}

.contact-card h3{
  color:#d9a52e;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}

.contact-card p{
  color:#c2c5ca;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}

/* FOOTER */
footer{
  padding:30px 0;
  background:#07090b;
  text-align:center;
  border-top:1px solid #25282d;
}

footer strong{
  color:#d9a52e;
}

footer p{
  color:#777;
  font-size:13px;
  margin-top:7px;
}

/* MOBILE */
@media(max-width:850px){

  nav{
    display:none;
  }

  .hero{
    min-height:620px;
  }

  .about-grid,
  .contact-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }

  .products{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  }

  .features,
  .process{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  }

  section{
    padding:65px 0;
  }

  .cta h2{
    font-size:32px;
  }
}

@media(max-width:520px){

  .logo{
    width:48px;
    height:48px;
  }


  .products,
  .features,
  .process{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }

  .hero p{
    font-size:16px;
  }

  .brand strong{
    font-size:13px;
  }

  h1{
    font-size:43px;
  }
}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<script>
document.getElementById("year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(link){
  link.addEventListener("click",function(e){
    const target=document.querySelector(this.getAttribute("href"));
    if(target){
      e.preventDefault();
      target.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
    }
  });
});
</script>
